balls.text: slower bouncer on middle, and hooked on a few bounces to fine leg. Kishan ends on 94*, having started the season with a century
excellently sliced over wide long-off! He goes deep in the crease, and clubs this slower ball on a full length outside off
another Pant-style swat!! He is off balance is reaching out for this slower ball, which is on a length, and wide of off. The ball was slapped to cover point, where Shepherd ended up diving over it
lovely bowling! It is a slower ball, and a dipping yorker on off at barely 102kph. Kishan goes swinging, and ends up toe-ending it towards square leg. They still pinch two, though
Cummins is nearly clueless, as this short ball pitches outside off, and shapes away. It was slower too, and Cummins ended up chopping it wide of the stumps on the leg side
well done by David at deep-backward square leg. In fact, he ends up at fine leg, and takes it on the bounce, as Kishan swipes this full toss angling into him

dropped by Ngidi! But that was a difficult chance. He turned around, and started chasing the ball, before diving forward. The ball hit his hands and dribbled away towards the long-off fielder running forward. It was a fullish ball, slow and wide of off, as Cummins went lofting down the ground but mistimed it
finally Cummins gets one away! Short of a length, but this is on middle. It is perfectly okay in line and length for Cummins to clear a big boundary, and get six over square leg
another slower delivery, and this time Cummins is beaten. It was fullish, and wide of off, and Cummins looked to swing across the line but missed
two more! Shortish in length, and wide of off. Cummins throw his bat at it in looking to hoick, but ends up chipping it in an ugly manner towards deep square leg
a slower bouncer on off, and Cummins gives it his all in looking to hook. The ball takes off from the top edge, and lands wide on the right of the man at deep square leg
slower ball, and on a length around sixth stump. Nudged down to long-off
full ball angling away, and around off. Jammed to long-off

a bit of Rishabh Pant there!! He times that beautifully, and loses his bottom hand off the bat, but still gets six over long-on. The ball was angling in, and arrived as a low full on his knees on middle

he shapes to reverse sweep, and Bhuvi bowls this very full and wide-ish of off. Kishan misses despite reaching out, and it's called wide. But Jitesh reviews. Replays show the ball slanting away, and pitching juuuuust about on the revised wide line. The third umpire is "satisfied" it's a wide, and RCB lose a review. But hang on, we're not done yet. The RCB players have gheraoed the on-field umpires, who call for another check. Kishan is deemed to have across the stumps, and hence, the ball is now within the revised line. So not a wide. and RCB retain their review
this is a yorker arriving bang on middle and off, and Kishan jams it towards deep extra cover. Two more Kishan in no time
sliced wonderfully over extra cover!! Kishan sees this ball swing away, and again come on as a low full on off. He opens the face of the bat very timely, and lofts this over a leaping David
bowls a lowish full toss slanting away to arrive just outside off. He drove to extra cover, from where the throw wasn't collected well by Bhuvi, and that allowed a second

taken with a juggle at deep midwicket!! Salt nearly dropped it, before catching the ball by going low. Shepherd continued to bowl the bouncer, and this one rose well on top of off after pitching outside it. Manohar backed away and looked to swat-pull it, but the ball ballooned up off the higher side of the bat. All Salt had to do was keep his eyes on it, which he did, and eventually took it after a second attempt
short of a length, and just outside off. Punched towards long-off
swept away over short fine leg! Kishan sees this low and dipping full toss coming on fifth stump, and goes low and slightly across to have a swipe
almost a carbon copy of the previous ball, but this isn't called wide. The ball swings away, and lands as a yorker around seventh stump. Kishan looks to jam at it with a horizontal bat, but misses
another slower delivery - at just 113kph - but this angles across, and lands very full and wide of off. Kishan lets it go, and it's called wide
another slower bouncer from Shepherd, and this comes on over middle and off after seaming in from outside off. Hooked to deep square leg
slower ball, and on a length around off. Manohar waits for it to come, before nudging it towards deep midwicket. Both batters are quick enough to push for and get two
another attempted yorker, but this ends up as a low full toss while swinging into middle. Punch-drive to long-off
nice yorker there. Bhuvi swings this away, and lands it bang on the base of off stump, as Kishan manages to squeeze it out to long-on
slower ball, and on the shorter side of a length in the corridor. Hacked away to deep cover point
over deep-backward point! Manohar simply reaches out for this short delivery which is climbing wide of off, and rides the bounce to ramp this for six. No foot movement there; just a flourish
another one short in length - although very slightly fuller than the previous ball - and around sixth stump. Slapped to extra cover again
short in length, and just outside off. He backs away slightly, and punches it towards the man at extra cover
short in length, and around sixth stump. Jabbed to point for a single, but the crowd is going gaga with Kohli having fielded the ball with a tumble
a yorker, but outside leg. The ball swung in again - is there some reverse? - as Reddy looked to flick but missed. The ball arrived just outside the line, though, but it's called wide
beaten! Manohar seems to be struggling against Shepherd. Short of a length, and in the channel just outside off. Manohar went back to try and punch, but the ball passed the outside edge
Kishan stays deep in the crease, and gets across, before slashing at this good-length ball just outside off to deep third

another bouncer, and this pings Manohar's helmet!! There will thus be the mandatory concussion check. Shepherd banged this hard on off, and Manohar, shaping to lean forward for a push, seemed to be stung by the extra bounce. The ball banged his forehead, went to deep third

taken at short fine leg! Shepherd strikes second ball. The ball arrives into Krunal's lap, and Reddy has to depart. Shepherd took pace off the ball, and bowled a bouncer. The ball seemed to have pitched on off or thereabouts, but finished right on middle. Reddy looked cramped for room, and looked to pull with his eyes taken off. The ball went off the top half of the bat, and right where Krunal was positioned
starts with a yorker, and then uses his footwork to prevent a run. The ball swings in and arrives on middle, as Reddy drives back, before Shepherd sticks his right leg out to stop the ball
backs away, and Krunal bowls short and outside off. He's lucky to get away, though, as Kishan finds the man at extra cover, to whom he slaps on the bounce
right in the gap between the men at long-on and deep square leg. Again Kishan clears his front leg, and launches at this length ball around leg for a boundary
this time he looks to swing this over the leg side, but ends up heaving at this length ball outside off on a few bounces to long-on
nearly chipped back to Krunal! He bowls this full and slow, and on middle, and Reddy pushes back at it
angles this across, and this time bowls on a length, and on fifth stump. Cut away to deep cover
Kishan shifts his weight back, and swipes at this good-length ball on the stumps to deep midwicket. Good, quick running from Reddy, and that lets Kishan complete his fifty
fuller side of a length on middle, and at only 121kph. Nudged to fine leg to keep ticking
full ball angling into the stumps, and Reddy flicks it to deep midwicket
another slower one, but this delivery is accurate from Ngidi. He bowls a yorker just outside off, and Kishan jams his bat down for a single towards long-on
reads the slower ball, and clears mid-off. The loft is rather with a flat bat, as this full ball angling into him arrives around fifth stump, and he goes with the line of the ball
on the fuller side of a length on middle and off, and pushed down to long-on
bowls one with a scrambled seam, and short of a length just outside off. Punched towards mid-on
on the bounce to the man at deep-backward square leg, as Kishan goes hard at this pull off a short ball on middle and leg
full, quick, and and straight. Clipped to fine leg to get off the mark

gone! Nearly a mix-up between the fielders, though. Eventually, Bhuvneshwar, who was at point, moves to his left and takes the ball in front of Ngidi, who was at short third. Aniket's fun ends, as Krunal slows it down, and uses his experience to check the flurry of sixes. Krunal angled it in, and bowled full on the stumps. Aniket went hoicking across the line - perhaps aiming to go over midwicket - but gets a leading edge behind
phew! Full toss just around off, and six more! Aniket keeps liking the long-off region - this is his third six there today - as this low full toss arrives at sixth stump, and he crashes the ball back
short of a length on leg, and this shapes to turn away. Whipped to deep square leg
highhh over deep square leg! The sound off the bat echoes around the ground. Kishan backs away, and Krunal bowls on a length outside leg. Kishan goes bam, and the ball flies for six
six more! Again he goes over long-off. Slower from Suyash, who goes much fuller this time. The ball dips on off, and Aniket again attacks this through the off side by going low
pulled wide of long-on! Suyash bowls this short on middle, and although the ball finishes on off, Aniket shifts his weight back to clobber it away for four
on a fullish length, and outside off again. It shapes to turn away, and is punched to long-off
the wrong 'un! This pitches on a length, and around fourth stump. Nudged to deep-backward square leg
bang! Comfortably clears the long-off boundary. Suyash tosses it up, and goes full and just outside off. Aniket gets his front leg out of the way, and pummels it through the line
angles this across on a fullish outside off, and turns away. Slapped to long-off
Pushed quicker on leg stump, he works this to deep midwicket for a run
Fuller and flatter outside off, he drags this to deep midwicket
Ooh, some turn. Was darted in on middle stump, he was looking to work that away, gets it off the leading edge past point
Oh, fetch that! Dragged down on middle stump, Kishan pulls and clears the deep midwicket fence with ease
Flatter angling away from Kishan who works to the right of short midwicket who dives and saves a run
Angled in on off stump, he pushes to long-off
Googly on middle and leg, he gets off the mark with a flick to deep midwicket

Klaasen is done for the day and it's the Suyash googly that does him in. Wrong'un that spins inside Klaasen's hitting arc on leg stump. He clears his left leg looking to clear long-on. Gets it nowhere near the middle of the bat and Shepherd does the rest
Drifts down leg again and Klaasen gets four again. Flatter on his pad, he nudges this fine. There are no fielders in the deep there
Wrong'un outside off, was short in length, he pats this to deep point
Two in two! Dragged down on middle and leg, he rocks back and hammers the pull to the left of deep midwicket. The fielder had about five steps to get to the ball, he moved two
Just over a leaping Kohli at extra cover. Tossed up well outside off, and he drives it with pace. Kohli leaps, gets fingertips on it but that was never a catch
Just a touch slower on a good length on middle, he works this towards long-off as Krunal gives chase. Tidy start for him
Flatter outside off, he looks to line this over deep midwicket but can only drag it to deep square leg
Darted in on off stump at 102kph, Klaasen stays back and leg side of the ball and mistimes back to the bowler
Goes good length on leg stump, he stays back and works this towards deep midwicket's right
Flatter on off stump, he backs away, and pushes to long-off
Darted in on a length on Kishan's pads as he flicks this to deep midwicket
Flatter and fuller outside off, he punches to long-off
Darted on his pads, he misses the flick but still collets a leg-bye to short fine leg
Going, going, gone! Floated on middle stump, was the googly. He gets under it and he hits it with the turn for an 85m six over long-on
Wayward delivery down leg and Klaasen gets four. Pushed quicker at 100.4kph on his pads, Klaasen nudges this fine and gets good result
Floated outside off at 89.8kph as Kishan drives to long-off
Googly tossed up outside off, he drives to extra cover where Kohli does the mopping up

Woohoo! What a way to end the powerplay. Into the surface outside off, not much pace on it and that's just sat up for Klaasen to get into position and smoke it miles over deep midwicket. That went 96m!
Juuuust over extra cover. Hard length outside off, he shimmies down the track looking to hammer that into orbit. Mistimes it completely but just evades the fielder
Crashed! Slower, loopy delivery but that was right in Kishan's slot outside off. He smashes this past mid-on's right for a four
On a length on off stump, he prods forward and pushes back to the bowler

Oof! So close to the leg stump. Kishan is really riding his luck. On a length cutting back into Kishan around off stump. He pushes at it, gets a thick inside-edge that was perilously close to the leg pole
On a good length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides past backward point

Did he get some bat there? Oh, he did. Wouldn't call that a chance... the ball was travelling but Jitesh did get a glove on it. Was a length ball down leg, he nudges this fine... a little too fine for his liking. Jitesh dives full-length to his right and actually saves two

A direct hit and Kishan was done for all money. There wasn't a single there, really. Good length on off, he punches to Ngidi at extra cover. Kishan is nowhere in the frame but Ngidi misses. He had more time that he thought to throw down the stumps
Nicely. Length ball right on off stump, Klaasen presents the full face of the bat and defends back to the bowler
On a length angling into Klaasen on off and middle. He defends to the on-side

Another one! Two wickets in three balls for RCB and SRH are suddenly in trouble. Knuckle ball on a length at 119.7kph on off stump. Head gets his right leg out of the way, trying to thrash this over mid-off. However, he gets deceived by the slowness of the delivery and hands a comfortable catch to Shepherd at mid-off
Fullish in length outside off, he drives on the up to extra cover

Oh, dear! Abhishek has flicked that straight down deep backward square leg's throat. A nothing delivery, really. Was a fuller-length ball down leg which he could have deposited anywhere. Manages to only find Salt who runs in a few steps to his left and completes a simple catch

He had made up his mind waaay too early and the line of the delivery made it easy for Abhishek. Slower back of a length ball on middle and leg. He gets right across and hooks/scoops to the vacant deep fine leg fence. 4000 T20 runs for Abhishek
Slower offcutter on off stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides to short third
Crunched! Back of a length ball outside off, he lays into it and thrashes it over extra cover and such is the power and the bat swing that the ball clears the boundary
Banged in short, rib-high on middle as he pulls to deep backward square leg
Not the best of starts for him. Loosener, gentle back of a length ball outside off, he stays still and pulls this through the vacant midwicket area
Another play and a miss. Short of a good length around off and middle stump. Abhishek dances down the track, gives himself room looking to smash that into next year. Only connects at thin air
The short ball almost does him in. Banged in short aiming for Abhishek's head even as he looks to back away. He misses and Jitesh has to collect that well over his head
UP AND OVER! Slightly pitched up and Abhishek brings that free swing of the bat into play. Length just outside off, he shuffles across just a touch and smokes this straight over the bowler's head
Top delivery. Banged in short at pace on middle aiming for Abhishek's body. He is late into his pull and gets beaten
Play and miss! Oh, is there an edge? Dayal is adamant and he's convinced the keeper. RCB go for a review. Scratch everything. Doesn't matter if there was an edge, because Dayal has overstepped.
BELTED! On a length shaping away from Abhishek outside off, he stands still and tonks this over extra cover. Was right in Abhishek's slot
Abhishek is hitting through the line like he mostly does. Good length ball veering away from the batter, who lifts it over covers. Not timed as well as he would have liked, but he will get two.
Shimmies down again, but Bhuvi follows him and strikes him on the pad as the duo take a leg-bye to round up the 18-run over
BANG! Marginally short of a length ball just outside off. He picks the length early and wallops this miles over deep midwicket for the first six of the innings
Down he goes and gets four more. Jumps down the track, gives himself some room and thrashes the good length ball over mid-off
Length on leg stump as he misses the flick and is struck on the pad. They pinch in a leg-bye
Good riposte, but Head still manages to get two. Good length ball angling away from Head who throws his hands at it, gets a thick inside edge that travels towards fine leg
Awry start for Bhuvneshwar as he starts too straight on Head's pads. He effortlessly flicks this to the vacant fine leg fence
Fuller outside off, he drives this on the up off the inside half of the bat as the ball crashes into the non-striker's stumps. Dayal didn't get anything on that on his followthrough.
Oh, the big booming inswinger that starts from well outside off and meets Abhishek on off as he square drives to deep point
On a good length just outside off, he pats this to short third
Good length ball nibbling away from Head outside off as he cuts to deep point for a run
Oh, what a shot to get off the mark. Fuller swinging away from Head well outside off. He reaches for it and just cue-ends it through. Still gets enough power to get the ball to the fence
A little inside edge upfront. Short of a good length just around off stump. He tentatively pokes at it without a lot of foot movement. Chops it perilously close to leg stump

taken at deep-backward square leg. Harshal finally gets a wicket. He bowls another bouncer, and outside off. The ball, once again, seamed back in. It finished around middle, as Dayal had a hook, but ended up sending it right where the fielder was positioned. SRH win by 42 runs
slower ball, and short and just outside off. The ball shapes back in to hit him on his body as he looks to pull but misses

Harshal goes wide of the crease, and bowls it full on off, and slower too. Dayal chips it back, and barely manages to clear mid-off, who was looking to grab it with the ball dropping over his shoulder
slower bouncer pitching outside off, but finishing on middle. Fended behind square after opening stance up
bowls on a length, and in the channel outside off. It is driven back hard, but Harshal stops it with his left hand
another yorker is launched, but Ngidi is careful in squeezing it out on middle and off
on a full length on off, and driven to point, as he opens the face of the bat

this is a yorker too, but pretty wide of off. And wait... Krunal is out hit wicket! He looked to have a slash at this ball, but ended up hitting the stumps off the bottom of the bat. It didn't matter after that whether he got bat on ball, although he did miss the delivery
another yorker, but this one comes on sixth stump. It is too full for Krunal to try and drive, and gets an inside edge there
there comes the yorker. The ball lands on off, and Dayal jams his bat down. The ball trickles away off the inside edge to go behind square

bowled him! How does the penalty matter?! On a length on middle and off, and Bhuvi looked to go over the off side after making a bit of room. But he was beaten on the outside edge - I thought the ball straightened after pitching, too - and the ball clattered into the middle and off stumps
outside edge, but four for Krunal! The ball flies between the keeper and short third, as he looked to loft this inswinging yorker-length ball just outside off
very full, and swinging into middle and off. Clipped to deep midwicket. The ball ricochets off a direct hit at the keeper's end to allow the third run

straight to long-on! Klaasen moves a step back, before taking the catch and tumbling. Malinga went for another yorker, but ended up bowling a full toss around knee height on off. David only went heaving across the line - he's in trouble with his injured right leg - and knew right away that he was gone
full and on off, as he swings this to deep-backward square leg. Still no run taken
another yorker - it's a big line of them now - as this comes on sixth stump. David only stands and slaps at it, and gets a bottom edge wide of the stumps
nicely done by Klaasen at long-on, who runs and slides to his right to prevent a boundary. David isn't fit enough to run, so it's a dot, as he had whipped this yorker wide of long-on
flung away over extra cover. This time he reads the slower ball, and lofts it late off a length. The line was wide again, and Krunal stretched out to place the ball in the acres of space available
on the fuller side of a length, and just outside off. Krunal can only punch it to Cummins at extra cover
another slower ball, and on a fullish length on a wide line outside off. Krunal looks to slash, but is beaten
a slower bouncer for the new batter. The ball lands on off, and is wat-pulled towards square leg. David hobbles his way to a single

another wicket!! RCB are losing track of this. Manohar, at deep midwicket, kept his eyes on the ball for a long while, before taking it comfortably. Unadkat bowled it on a fullish length, and on off. Jitesh was deep in the crease, and although this was in his hitting arc, he ended up heaving it exactly where the fielder was present
Jitesh makes room, and drives this full ball on leg to extra cover

gone first ball! There's another Malinga to remember now. He bowls a slower ball to the new batter, and Shepherd ends up chipping it back to Malinga's left. He had backed away early, and Malinga bowled full and on middle or thereabouts. No timing or placement from Shepherd, and Malinga has turned it around for SRH
another inswinging yorker on middle, and Jitesh can only heave it to short fine leg off the inside edge

gone! Direct hit from Malinga! There as a near collision between the batters mid-pitch, and Patidar found himself way short of the crease. It was yet another well executed yorker from Malinga, who went just outside off. Patidar jammed his bat at it to get it dribbling towards the off side. Malinga rushed forward to his left, grabbed the ball, and launched a throw at the bowler's end
a yorker length again - Malinga has been very good so far this over - as this arrives on middle. Jitesh whips this to deep midwicket
this lands very full, and around off. Good bowling, as Patidar can only drive it to long-off

ohh, he does pretty well to bowl a yorker, but that ends up in four leg byes. Malinga swung this in, and ended up outside leg, as Patidar looked to clip, but the ball took his pads to beat the keeper to his left
a low full toss arriving on middle, and whipped on the bounce to deep midwicket. This is now RCB's first over without a boundary
a short ball slightly wide of off, and Patidar is beaten as he looks to ramp after leaping in the crease
good bowling again. This time he nails a yorker on middle and off, which Jitesh can only squeeze to extra cover
ohh, well spotted by Reddy! He saw Jitesh get across and attempt the scoop very early, so he bowled short and around seventh stump. Jitesh then had no option but to duck
another low full toss, but this is on middle and leg. He pushes forward to long-on, with his bottom hand off the bat
Jitesh looks to distract the bowler by getting across and then backing away. Reddy eventually bowls a low full toss outside leg, which is clipped to deep square leg
again Unadkat bowls a yorker, as this one swings in and arrives on middle. Jitesh looks to clip, but gets a leading edge to deep extra cover
another yorker, and this is on off. Whipped to long-on by Patidar
slower ball, and full and just outside off. It is a punch drive from Patidar, who manages to play it just wide of long-off for two
great comeback! Unadkat swings this in, and lands the yorker on middle and off. But Jitesh does well to still open the face of the bat, and squeeze it to short third
sliced over for six! The ball goes over extra cover, as he opens the face of the bat at this fullish ball, and gets the maximum after getting his front leg out of the way

difficult chance missed!! Abhishek was at deep midwicket, and he went low while moving to his right. But the ball dropped just past his hands, and went for four, as Jitesh had whipped this full ball angling into off
shorter side of a length just outside off, and Patidar opens the face of the bat to punch this to point
shortish in length on off, and clipped to deep midwicket
lofted up... and it falls between long-off and deep cover moving in each other's direction. On a fullish length, and around sixth stump, as Patidar didn't time his attempted loft off a slower ball
Harshal goes wide of the crease, and on the shorter side of a length on off. Nudged to deep midwicket, and they push for two
another slower ball, but this time he's beaten. On a short of a length, and a little wide of off. Patidar looks to slash, but misses out
punched to deep third! Short in length, and around sixth stump. The ball shapes back in - it's a slower delivery - and Patidar gets on top of the bounce to beat a diving point to his right
an inswinging yorker-length ball on middle, and flicked to midwicket
another wide in the over. Cummins bowls the slower bouncer, but it is too short. It pitches outside off but finishes on middle, as Jitesh lets it go
on a length on off, as he gets slightly across before clipping to deep midwicket
this one is a low full toss swinging into off, and is clipped to wide long-on
ramped for six first ball! Short in length, and around fifth stump, as Jitesh waited for the ball to come, before playing very late, and going over the keeper

he cries "oh, no!" the moment the ball leaves the bat, and Salt is gone! Cummins bowls a fullish ball around off, which Salt looked to attack by opening his stance up, and going deep in the crease. He ended up slicing it back down the ground, and sent the ball high enough for Harshal, who was at mid-off, who half turn around, ahead towards mid-on to take this
wide outside off. Cummins floats this pretty full, and Salt looks to drive, but misses. Kishan isn't happy with the wide call
shorter side of a length, and slightly wide of off. Guided to deep third by Patidar

wow!! A tennis-batted swat for six over long-off. Short delivery around fifth stump, and Salt decides that the best way to get on top of the bounce is by standing deep in the crease, and attacking it through the line. He remained unmoved after smacking the ball away
short in length, and wide of off. Slapped to cover point

edged behind to Kishan! Reddy went on the fuller side of a length, and in the corridor outside off. Agarwal got his front leg out of his way, and went lofting. But the ball took the outside edge, and went to Kishan's right. Simple catch, and RCB are hit again

ohh, somehow he got bat on ball! He first seemed to drag his back leg back, then shaped to scoop, and finally got the ball off the edge towards cover, as Reddy bowled on the shorter side, and outside off
Reddy swings this in, and bowls a very full and straight ball. It is whipped to deep midwicket by Salt
starts with a short delivery around fifth stump. Pulled to deep square leg
Fullish on middle, he whips this to the left of deep backward square leg for two more.
Oh, my word how's that missed off stump! Lovely dipping slower yorker that does Salt all ends up. He misses as the ball just misses off stump
Fifty for Salt, off just 27 balls! He's missed a couple of games and won't RCB be glad to have him back. Overpitched outside off, he pummels this over extra cover to reach another milestone.
Fuller on middle, he punches this to long-on. Such sweet timing displayed so far from Mayank
Is filthy with himself there is Salt for not getting more on that. Was in the slot on middle, he shanks this to long-on
Nails the yorker but Salt has still managed to squeeze this to the left of short fine leg for a couple of runs
Hangs this around off stump, salt drives to long-off
Angled in on middle, he ticks this to the on-side for a run
Straight down the ground and Reddy, for the second time today has almost over-run the ball. He hares to his left, but this time keeps the ball inside the field of play.
Flatter on middle and leg stump, he pulls to deep midwicket
FETCH THAT! Not a drag down by any stretch of the imagination. Was marginally short if any on leg stump, but Salt has picked the length so early and deposited this miles over deep midwicket
Hint of turn as he gives the ball a rip and lands it on middle stump. He works this to deep midwicket with soft hands
Easy pickings and Salt says thank you, so much for the gift. Knee-high full toss around off stump. Salt sends this soaring over mid-off and eventually clears the ropes with minimum of fuss
Back of a length ball on the stumps, he nails the pull but straight to deep midwicket
Freebie and Patel takes toll. Short of a length ball but that is way too wide, as Mayank cuts this up and above point
Slower offcutter again on middle and leg, he works this to short midwicket
Slower offcutter outside off, he chops this to deep cover

Smashed back... Harshal had no chance. On a length just on off stump, he absolutely smokes it back to the right of the bowler, and the ball was out of his reach before he could even get his right hand up

Kohli does not score a fifty in a run chase for a change. Tossed up on middle stump, Kohli backs away but it is the extra bounce that does him in. Looks for a cut, but ends up slicing this straight to point where Abhishek does the rest. Dubey is ecstatic and why not!
Slows this up on a length around off stump, he scythes it to extra cover
Backs away and clears the ropes with ease. Flatter on the stumps, he gives himself room and hammers this over deep midwicket
Darted on off stump, he backs away but only slices to point
Flatter on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket
Angles the length ball on middle, he pushes to the bowler
Fuller in length on leg stump, he squeezes it out and is lucky the ball trickles close to the stumps
Six more! Bangs the short of a length ball outside off, he cuts this up and over point using the pace and gets six
Low full toss on pace on off stump, he mistimes it back to the bowler
Slower offcutter but that was too full outside off. Salt gets under it and hammers it over mid-off
On-pace length ball on middle, he looks to hoick this to the on-side, gets a thick inside-edge to short fine leg
And he's welcomed to the bowling crease with a huge six. Slower offcutter on the stumps, he backs away and heaves this over deep midwicket
Another yorker on middle stump which is dug out to long on by Kohli for a run
Nails the yorker on middle as Salt squeezes this to mid-on
Heaved away for four! Also brings RCB's fifty in 4.4 overs.  Slower offcutter at 116kph on his hips. He shuffles and helps this to the deep backward square leg fence
Too high... called a wide. Banged in short but that was way too high over Salt's head.
On-pace length ball on middle, he ticks this to the on-side and takes a quick run

How has he threaded the gap? Wowza! Legcutter dug into the track on middle. Kohli shimmies down the track and gives himself room. Adjusts to the pace and rolls his wrists as he guides the ball off the face. In all this he still finds small gap between short third and point.
Slower back of a length bouncer on off, he pulls to deep backward square leg for a run
Beaten all ends up. Slower back of a length delivery at 122.7kph outside off. He is way to early into the pull and only connects at thin air
Too high? Nope, one-bouncer for the over. Rising bouncer around off stump, that continues to climb pas Kohli's outside edge. Klaasen leaps and saves a few extra runs
Sharp back of a length ball on off, he runs this off the face of the bat to short third
Slower bouncer as Kohli backs away and Harshal follows him. But this was down leg even as Kohli missed the pull
Oh, lovely! Overpitched outside off, he stays still and lofts this up and over mid-off. Pure class from Kohli.
On a length angling away from Kohli outside off, he uses his wrists and lofts this to the left of deep extra cover
Another shin-high full toss outside off, he spoons it straight up with Reddy taking the catch at extra cover but to no avail. Two balls, two catches, no wickets.

Straight down deep midwicket's throat. The question is... how high was that delivery? The technology will come into play. On first glance, it looked quite high, but was it above the waist? A very high full toss to begin with on off stump. Salt is a foot or so outside the crease and shanks this to Abhishek who takes a comfortable catch. But, but... the technology comes to Salt's rescue. The ball was at 0.98m, his waist was at 0.95m. So, it's a no-ball

Another misfield and Kohli gets two more. Angles the length ball on middle stump, he charges down the track, goes for big heave, can only manage a thick inside-edge to short fine leg, who dives over the ball
Kohli is pinned on the helmet this time around. Right on the badge of the helmet. Sharp bouncer aiming for Kohli's head. He is late on the pull, misses and the ball hits smack on the middle

And this time, Reddy has over-run the ball and concedes four more. It's not his night so far. Low full toss on his pad, Kohli flicks this to Reddy's right, who sprints too quickly to his own liking. He went right, the ball went to his left.
On the fuller side just around off stump, Salt mistimes to mid-off
Backs away but Cummins follows him and cramps him for room. Kohli gets a thick inside-edge onto pad

Oh, he's misjudged it has Nitish Reddy. Banged in short, Kohli pulls straight to deep backward square leg where Reddy runs in. Had he been on the ropes, that would have gone straight down his throat. But he came in, and the ball evaded his leap
Back of a length ball following Salt who was backing away. He pulls through square leg but the fielder sprints to his right and saves two
Stays leg side of the ball but Unadkat keeps it on off stump, not giving any room. He can only bunt it to mid-off

Oh, Klaasen's got a glove to it. Was that a catch? Nope, right off the pad. Kohli backs away looking to access the offside. But Unadkat follows him, cramping him for room. He wears it on the thigh pad as the ball lobs to the left of Klaasen who runs and dives full-length to his left.
On a length on leg stump, he tickles this fine to  the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Back of a length ball angling across Kohli, who stays back and punches this to the left of mid-off for another four
Good length ball slanting back into Kohli rapping him on the thigh pad as he misses the flick
On a length at pace on middle and leg, he ticks it to the short midwicket fielder

Pinged on the helmet, but RCB get four leg-byes. Excellent bouncer directed at Salt's body. He is late onto the pull and is hit on the back of the helmet. The ball flies to the right of the keeper. The physio is out to check on Salt. He seems fine. Has a change of helmet and is okay to continue. Sports a big smile, which is good to see
Rising short of a good length ball just around off stump. He splices this towards point
On a length on middle and leg stump, Kohli works this to short midwicket
And he's off straight away. Back of a length ball angling away from Kohli who throws his bat at it and slashes it over point
On-pace back of a length ball on leg stump, he misses the swish and pull and wears it on the pad as the ball lobs to the on-side
